8033.title: Provider archive rejection is not surfaced
8033.rootCauseOneLine: Local archive succeeds before detached provider settlement; failures only log, and repeating archive skips provider dispatch.
8033.proposedFix: Define a shared provider-sync outcome and idempotent retry contract before changing lifecycle/API/presentation.
8033.caveats: Server fault-injection reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout; Windows native writer conflict and Desktop state were not exercised. No simple fix PR because the full behavior needs product/API or persistence decisions.
